protocol.scope: LQR baseline plus bounded PPO residual; no full-command switching
protocol.causal_contract: 20 channels with 14/15/16/17/19 always zero. Deliver available packet BEFORE observation. Held residual/age is observable. No pending residual, future completion time or service oracle. Queries only submitted when idle. Busy-tick sampled actions are ignored by executor. Original observation timestamps persist.
protocol.normalization: Frozen causal student TRAIN-only normalization, same per paired scratch/finetune. Existing supervised DEV selected student initialization is extra pretraining, not equal total budget.
protocol.training: Uniform 15/20/25 m/s, sine120/DLC220, left/right mirror, nominal/tire/delay20/delay100; shared initial scenario streams by seed, no extra tuning. Plant continues every 10ms while queued action unavailable.
protocol.fusion: clip(baseline + weight * clip(residual,-0.08,0.08),-0.5,0.5); actual actuator rate 0.35rad/s, lag0.05s shared all methods
protocol.latency_gain_comparator: Documented manuscript-inspired reconstruction, not exact original reproduction: gain0.5 for age<=5ms, else0.5*exp(-0.8*(age_ms-5)); identical50ms stale cutoff. Uses measured simulated packet age, not unknown completion forecasts.
protocol.reward: -(ey/0.5)^2 -0.2*(heading_error/0.1)^2 -0.005*(command/0.5)^2 -0.001*((command-last_command)/0.005)^2 -10*failure; no penalty for exogenous computation delay. Reward-only VecNormalize. No privileged teacher bonus.
protocol.acceptance: Development finetune >=1% lower mean penalized lateral RMSE than LQR, same-supervisor student and BOTH fixed corrections; all3 seed gains positive vs student; no survival loss; nominal no more than2% worse than LQR; overall headingRMSE and steeringRateRMS <=1.05 LQR; exact delay100 baseline. All checks must pass. Smoke never selects or unlocks confirmation.
protocol.confirmation: Only after full development passes, evaluate the frozen25000-step endpoint on new noise and held-out sine145 path parameters, all3 seeds, 15/25m/s, both mirrors, same4 scenarios and methods. Separate manifest before opening. Native/timing remain separate.
protocol.stop: Exactly6x25000 additional PPO steps. No extensions or altered seeds/gate/cost after results. Failure leaves confirmation unopened. Physical testing unavailable; no formal safety, guaranteed100Hz, energy or GPU-speedup claim. Published-algorithm reproduction requires verified implementation and remains explicitly pending.

real_worker.criterion: All raw contract checks pass; deadlines assessed separately, any miss fails strict observed timing. Finite tests cannot establish WCET.

normalization: frozen causal TRAIN; same paired scratch/finetune
